test_title: PYST 55: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her presentation was both informative and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**entertaining**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**entertaining**" is an adjective that appropriately describes her presentation as both "informative" and engaging.
 
• Options 1 ("entertainer") and 2 ("entertain") are incorrect because they do not grammatically fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3 ("entertainingly") is an adverb, which is not suitable here since the sentence requires an adjective.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Her presentation was both informative and **entertaining**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "entertainer"** is incorrect because it refers to a person, not a quality of the presentation.
 
• **Option 2: "entertain"** is incorrect because it is a verb and does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: "entertainingly"** is incorrect because it is an adverb and not suitable in this context.
